actual_hs_list: 283990 (silicates, incl. potassium/sodium/lithium silicate, liquid/powder/lumps); 284190 or 284990 (potassium/magnesium-potassium/lithium-potassium titanates - exact subheading needs confirmation); 261400 (natural rutile sand); 261400 (ilmenite sand); 261510 (zircon sand); 382499 (chemical preparations/binders, mixed silicate preparations, geopolymer alkali activators)
product_summary: Official site noblealchem.com (est. 1986, Bhiwani, Haryana) lists: potassium silicate (powder/liquid), sodium silicate (powder/liquid), lithium silicate, mixed silicates; potassium titanate, magnesium potassium titanate, lithium potassium titanate under brand TINO (fibrous/whisker TINO-F, non-fibrous TINO-FF, mixed structures) for brake pads/friction, welding electrode flux, plastics reinforcement; mineral sands - natural rutile sand, ilmenite sand, zircon sand (rutile/ilmenite page states they are a supplier, procured from global locations). Applications: welding electrodes, construction/concrete densifiers, paints & coatings, oil-well drilling fluids, adhesives, soil grouting, acid proofing, geopolymer, agriculture (potassium silicate fertilizer), detergents, textiles, timber treatment.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - silicates and titanates are stated as manufactured in-house (own QC lab: XRF, PSA, SEM, viscometer); mineral sands (rutile/ilmenite/zircon) are explicitly described as procured/supplied, i.e. trading line.
comment: Declared 283990 is corroborated by the product range: silicates (sodium, potassium, lithium, mixed) fall under HS 2839 'Silicates'. Declared 382499 is plausible for mixed silicate preparations, binders and geopolymer alkali activators, but no product page names a specific preparation under 3824 - treat as partial. MISSING from the declaration: (1) titanates - potassium titanate, magnesium potassium titanate, lithium potassium titanate (TINO brand) are a core, branded product line and are NOT silicates; they belong to titanium compounds (HS 2823 titanium oxides or 2841/2849 titanates - exact 6-digit code must be confirmed with the supplier's technical data sheet, not asserted here); (2) mineral sands - natural rutile sand, ilmenite sand (HS 2614) and zircon sand (HS 2615) are a separate traded line absent from the declared codes. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only partly accurate: oil-well drilling fluids are one application among many; the real profile is inorganic silicates/titanates for welding, friction/brake, construction and agriculture - a specialty inorganic chemicals maker, not an oil & gas company. Trader signs: mineral sands are stated as procured from global locations and resold, so that line is trading, not manufacturing. All product claims above come from the company's own website only - no customs line was available in this task, therefore every product/HS mapping is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained and the code list should be corrected/extended to include titanates and mineral sands.
